[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Encouraging regular cleaning and disinfecting of public areas, especially high-touch surfaces.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Promoting vaccination drives against common infectious diseases.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Constant monitoring and tracing of suspected cases to contain the spread.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Building hospital infrastructure and emergency response systems for sudden surges in patients.  
[USER] User heard that some infectious diseases spread through contaminated water and asked for prevention methods.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested effective ways to prevent the spread of water-borne infectious diseases:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Ensure a clean and safe water supply through proper treatment and maintenance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Promote water hygiene, such as using clean water for drinking and cooking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Regular cleaning and disinfection of water storage facilities.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Build proper sanitation facilities to prevent water contamination.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Implement water testing programs to detect contamination.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Create awareness about water-borne diseases and promote hygiene habits.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Improve accessibility to clean water in high-risk areas.  
[USER] User expressed appreciation for the suggestions and asked what to do if the water supply is already contaminated.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested steps to take if the water supply is contaminated:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Boil water for at least one minute before use.
